title: Tinubu Achievement Tracker Canonical Vocabulary v1.1
description: Authoritative machine-readable controlled vocabulary dictionary for research, ingestion, database, and frontend systems.

record_types.internal_description: Positive demonstrable administration milestone or outcome meeting publication criteria
Guiding principle, national framework, or structured government strategy
Systemic or structural adjustment to economic, fiscal, or institutional arrangements
Direct presidential directive, executive order, or official committee determination
Statute passed by the National Assembly and assented to by the President
Enforceable subsidiary instrument issued by an authorized regulatory agency
Structured multi-initiative government operational framework over time
Targeted welfare, relief, subsidy, or palliative initiative for specific cohorts
Tangible civil works, transport, energy, building, or engineering asset
Restructuring, digitization, or operational improvement of an MDA
Measurable societal, economic, or operational result resulting from government action
Chronological occurrence associated with a record lifecycle
Substantive delivery stage within an ongoing project or reform
Quantitative statistical time series measuring national or sector performance
Specific dated data point for a defined indicator
Document, dataset, official gazette, or publication providing factual evidence
Audited post-publication adjustment, correction, or retraction of a published claim
Synthesized thematic or periodic review publication
Structured tabular data release published for external transparency
Formal research standard, calculation method, or verification procedure

implementation_statuses.internal_description: Concept submitted or discussed in official policy formulation
Formally publicized by the President, Minister, or official spokesperson
Sanctioned by competent authority such as the Federal Executive Council (FEC)
Statute passed by legislature and assented into law
Legal instrument or policy has reached its official commencement date
Financial allocation committed in statutory budget or financing facility
Warrants or cash backed allocations disbursed to implementing MDA
Formal bidding, compliance, or contract award in progress
Detailed engineering, operational designs, or frameworks being finalized
Active physical construction, reform rollout, or service delivery
Substantive component, phase, or section delivered and usable
Full scope of works or implementation milestones delivered
Asset or system is actively serving the public or operational purpose
Official or empirical evidence demonstrates measurable public impact
External audit, multilateral review, or peer review confirms outcome
Temporarily paused by executive, judicial, or administrative instruction
Replaced by subsequent policy, project phase, or legal instrument
Formally cancelled, nullified, or struck down by competent authority
Implementation status undergoing active factual re-assessment
Historical record retained for documentation but no longer active
Claim or record retracted due to falsification or material error

publication_statuses.internal_description: Unpublished researcher draft undergoing initial composition
Undergoing formal quality control gate reviews
Approved and visible to the public without reservations
Published with visible contextual notes, data limitations, or provisional flags
Failed editorial or evidentiary verification standards
Superseded historical public record kept for audit trail

workflow_statuses.internal_description: Initial extraction and researcher data entry
Senior editorial review of factual neutrality and clarity
Signed off by authorized lead editor / human reviewer
Active in production dataset and public application

data_value_classifications.internal_description: Observed, audited, or finalized historical figure
Interim reported figure subject to formal revision or year-end audit
Forward-looking target or forecasted future figure
Stated administrative aspiration, KPI, or delivery target
Direct arithmetic derivation from primary official numbers

source_origin_classifications.internal_description: Reported directly by an official government MDA, spokesperson, or portal
Produced by an independent multilateral, research institute, or external audit
Joint assessment by government and external development partners

verification_statuses.internal_description: Direct citation verified against primary source document
Corroborated across two or more consistent official sources
Confirmed by non-governmental or international institutional evidence
Competing figures or contradictory evidence identified and logged
Prior error officially corrected via formal revision
Retracted from verification due to unreliability

evidence_profiles.internal_description: Evidence includes site coordinates, contractor awards, and commissioning records
Evidence includes official gazette, enacted Act number, or signed executive order
Evidence includes treasury release, payment platform audit, or beneficiary receipts
Evidence includes time-series data from NBS, CBN, DMO, or international statistical bodies
Evidence includes published national policy framework or FEC extract
Evidence includes independent civil society, academic, or professional evaluation
Evidence includes World Bank, IMF, AfDB, or UN project completion report
Evidence includes agency restructuring decree, portal launch, or service standard audit

source_levels.public_label: Level 1: Primary Legal and Administrative Records
source_levels.internal_description: Acts of National Assembly, Official Gazettes, Executive Orders, FEC Approvals, Signed Bilateral Treaties

source_levels.public_label: Level 2: Official Statistical and Administrative Data
source_levels.internal_description: NBS statistical bulletins, CBN economic reports, DMO debt reports, Budget Office implementation reports, MDA official records

source_levels.public_label: Level 3: International and Independent Institutional Evidence
source_levels.internal_description: World Bank, IMF, AfDB, UN agency reports, NEITI audits, certified independent technical audits

source_levels.public_label: Level 4: Credible Mainstream and Specialist Media
source_levels.internal_description: Reputable national newspapers, international wire services, peer-reviewed journals, verified investigative reports

source_levels.public_label: Level 5: Official Statements and Contextual Material
source_levels.internal_description: Official ministerial press briefings, State House press releases, government portal announcements, verified official speeches
Unverified leads, social posts from verified channels, uncorroborated announcements (INTERNAL ONLY - NEVER PRIMARY PUBLIC PROOF)

source_roles.internal_description: The authoritative primary legal or administrative document establishing the claim
Government statistical publication supplying empirical baseline or outcome data
MDA project log, contractor delivery certificate, or operational telemetry
Non-governmental or multilateral review evaluating delivery or impact
Secondary source verifying the existence or progress of the claim
Provides background, baseline context, or operational framing
Provides broader sector, macro, or historical setting
Provides competing, disputed, or divergent factual claims
Supersedes an earlier inaccurate or broken evidence link
Historical snapshot of a source that has modified or moved
Initial trigger that led researchers to investigate the achievement

financial_value_types.internal_description: Amount appropriated in the National Budget (Appropriation Act)
Funding approved by FEC, presidential directive, or bilateral financing agreement
Cash or warrants released by the Ministry of Finance / Accountant-General
Actual audited or reported funds disbursed to contractors, vendors, or beneficiaries
Total formal commercial value of an awarded procurement contract
Multi-year funding envelope allocated for an overarching programme
Direct sovereign equity or capital funding invested in infrastructure/enterprises
Private sector capital committed or disbursed in co-financing or FDI
Actual fiscal, customs, tax, or FX revenue collected
Projected future revenue from a tax, tariff, or policy reform
Calculated or reported expenditure reduction resulting from reform or subsidy removal

beneficiary_stages.internal_description: Individual or entity that submitted an application or registration form
Entity successfully captured on the programme database or portal
Applicant verified as meeting all statutory programme criteria
Screened applicant formally approved for benefit or award
Approved beneficiary who has received verified financial or in-kind payout
Entity currently receiving ongoing programme services, loans, or subsidies

beneficiary_types.internal_description: Micro, small, or medium commercial enterprise
Recipient of medical treatments or subsidized care

date_precisions.internal_description: Full calendar date verified in source
Known month and year; exact day unspecified
Bounded period between start and end dates

geographic_scope_types.internal_description: Nationwide scope across all 36 States and FCT
One of the six recognized geopolitical zones
Specific physical coordinates or facility location
Interstate highway, rail line, pipeline, or economic transit zone
Maritime zone, exclusive economic zone, or international boundary

relationship_roles.internal_description: Record delivers or operationalizes the target policy or act
Record was authorized or funded by the target reform or statute
Record represents a sequential phase within a larger umbrella project
Record represents an empirical result produced by the target action
Record replaces or updates an earlier historical project or policy
Record has contextual or thematic relevance to the target

correction_types.internal_description: Update of descriptive text or operational progress
Audited correction of financial amount, beneficiary count, or metric
Adjustment of implementation or verification status
Addition of higher-tier evidence or replacement of broken link
Correction of state coverage or responsible MDA
Removal of sensitive or non-public information
Complete withdrawal of an erroneous claim from public display

freshness_statuses.internal_description: Verified within the established velocity window
Exceeded review velocity; flagged for priority research check
Unverified for extended duration; requires immediate verification check
Completed historical event requiring no further freshness review

research_risk_levels.internal_description: Standard official Gazette, Act of Parliament, or routine administrative milestone
Infrastructure progress claim, operational milestone, or standard fiscal figure
Major fiscal claim (>₦100B), major beneficiary total (>500k), security milestone, or disputed claim
Major legal liability, constitutional claim, extreme political sensitivity, or major contradiction requiring multi-reviewer sign-off
